title: Phinary
text:
Phinary base is golden ratio base.

It used golden-ratio as its radix.

It counts by powers of the golden ratio

It uses only 2 digits like binary.

You are never allowed to write two 1's next to each other (like "11"). If you ever get "11", you must rewrite it as "100". This is because in this system, adding two of any power together equals the next higher power
